tools.name: natal_chart
tools.description: A natal chart from birth data. "part" picks what to return: full (everything: bodies with sign, degree, speed, retrograde flag and house; the angles; twelve Placidus cusps; aspects with orbs; element and quality balance; fixed-star contacts), short (Sun, Moon and Ascendant, each body's sign, retrogr

tools.name: daily_transits
tools.description: The calculated day: the sky at noon UTC, the Moon's phase, the sky events of the coming week and, with birth data, every transit to the natal chart with its orb. No generated text.

tools.name: sky
tools.description: Planetary positions, Moon phase and the coming week's sky events for a date (?date=YYYY-MM-DD, today by default).

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Your plan, today's count and when the pool refills. Costs nothing.

tools.name: transits
tools.description: Every transit event in a window of up to 92 days: exact transit-to-natal aspects by date, sign ingresses and stations. (API Pro)

tools.name: synastry
tools.description: Two charts compared: inter-chart aspects with orbs, house overlays both ways and a score per life sphere. (API Pro)

tools.name: solar_return
tools.description: The solar return chart for a year, cast for the birth place or another location. (API Pro)

tools.name: best_days
tools.description: Every day of a window of up to 62 days scored for one activity (general, business, romance, health, creative, travel, home, clarity): helping and hindering transits, Moon phase and sign, void of course. The five best days first. (API Pro)

tools.name: location_score
tools.description: One place against one chart: the relocated angles, the planets on them with orbs, and a score for each life sphere. (API Pro)

tools.name: best_cities
tools.description: The catalogue of major cities ranked for one chart, overall or by chosen life spheres, worldwide or in one region. (API Pro)
